parameters.query:
SELECT 'nuevo' AS tipo, c.name AS competidor, p.title AS producto, p.sku, p.url,
       NULL AS antes, s.price AS ahora, NULL AS antes_ok, NULL AS ahora_ok,
       NULL AS visto, p.first_seen AS fecha
FROM products p
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
LEFT JOIN product_snapshots s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.captured_at = p.first_seen
WHERE p.first_seen >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'precio', c.name, p.title, p.sku, p.url,
       pe.old_price, pe.new_price, NULL, NULL,
       NULL, pe.detected_at
FROM price_events pe
JOIN products p ON p.id = pe.product_id
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
WHERE pe.detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'stock', c.name, p.title, p.sku, p.url,
       NULL, NULL, ae.was_available, ae.now_available,
       NULL, ae.detected_at
FROM availability_events ae
JOIN products p ON p.id = ae.product_id
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
WHERE ae.detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

UNION ALL

SELECT 'baja', c.name, p.title, p.sku, p.url,
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       p.last_seen, p.removed_at
FROM products p
JOIN competitors c ON c.id = p.competitor_id
WHERE p.status = 'removed' AND p.removed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND c.name NOT IN ('Fitness Tech', 'Fitness Tech FR', 'Fitness Tech PT')

ORDER BY competidor, fecha DESC;
